name: leetcode-coach
description: Offline-first LeetCode interview coach: FSRS reviews, interleaved daily practice, timed mock interviews, spoken explanations scored by Claude, and a live shared whiteboard. React PWA + Hono/PostgreSQL sync API.

paragraphs: A local-first study coach for LeetCode interview prep. It decides what to practice today, schedules reviews with spaced repetition, keeps structured notes, and runs timed mock interviews with think-aloud recording. You can use it without an account; signing in syncs your data across devices.
You still solve problems on LeetCode. This app handles the parts around solving: planning, remembering, and explaining.
Live app: — it runs on free hosting that sleeps when idle, so the first visit after a while can take about a minute to wake up. After that it's fast, and once loaded it keeps working offline.
features: Study lists: NeetCode 150, Blind 75 and Grind 169 (213 unique problems), grouped into 18 patterns. You can add any other LeetCode problem.

Interview sprint: enter the interview date, the company (optional), and how many minutes you have on weekdays and weekends. Every day until the interview gets a plan, and the last days (2 by default) are review only.

New problems come in priority order: problems tagged with the company, then one problem from each pattern you haven't touched, then two more from patterns you keep forgetting, then the rest of your list. Each day takes…

Reviews are forecast with FSRS, including the first reviews of problems you'll learn during the sprint. A problem you'd remember with less than 90% chance on the interview day is pulled into the review-only days.
One full mock interview two days before (and every week before that), and behavioral practice every three days ending the day before. Today shows the countdown, today's minutes, and these to-dos.

requirements.text: You can use it without an account; signing in syncs your data across devices.
No account needed to look around: on the Today page, press Try it with demo data to fill the app with six weeks of made-up practice (reviews due, a streak, a heatmap, stuck patterns).
Requires an account; the server holds the API key and enforces a daily limit per user.
AI feedback needs an API key from the Claude Console.
